newsitem.title: USA: Tenn. cable group seeks Bellsouth probe.
newsitem.headline: Tenn. cable group seeks Bellsouth probe.

text.p: Tennessee cable television operators have asked state regulators to investigate whether BellSouth Corp was building a cable television infrastructure without local authorization, an industry group said Tuesday.

The Tennessee Cable Telecommunications Association said it asked the Tennessee Regulatory Authority to investigate whether the phone company was using phone customers' money to fund the construction and engaging in other anticompetitive practices.
BellSouth Corp was not immediately available for comment.

"The evidence strongly suggests that BellSouth is systematically installing a cable television network without the knowledge or authorization of local cable franchise authorities," the group's president, Craig Perica, said.
Perica said the group was asking regulators to audit BellSouth's finances.
The complaint also asked regulators to order BellSouth to refund any amount it may have overcharged subscribers, the group said.
